capabilities: toggle crease markers on headings and list items
fold along creases and iron out creases in a file
save current folds as creases and restore them later
increase or decrease heading fold levels
auto-fold creased content from Templates or Templater templates
extras: The crease marker is a %% fold %% comment placed on the same line as the heading or list item.
problem: Obsidian's folds are easily lost (e.g. a search unfolds everything) and folding many headings at a given depth by hand is tedious.

relations.evidence: Templater support – Add creases to your Templater templates to have content automatically folded.
If you use the Templates core plugin, any creases included in your template will automatically be folded.

summary: Folding utility that marks sections with comment markers (creases) and adds commands to fold, restore, and adjust folds in notes.
